items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png) Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2024, and the first to be held in the Northern Suburbs! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, with multiple rounds of 3x3, 2x2, and Pyraminx, as well as one round of 4x4 and Skewb. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). **About CubingZA** CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please get in touch by contacting us [here](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.name: Ottawa Spring 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://youtu.be/vz1V0Gv0qX0?si=7y524qUInNbtHtVz Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://youtu.be/vz1V0Gv0qX0?si=7y524qUInNbtHtVz Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ## Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing! - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of. - We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

items.name: German Open 2024
items.information: In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2024 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun! Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2024 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.information: 🇦🇴 **Bem-vindos à 2ª competição oficial da WCA em Angola!** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LuandaOpen2024/register). items.information: **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024** Es la segunda competencia del nuevo año 2024. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia official de la World Cube Association. La competencia es abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, el registro esta habilitado desde la página oficial de la WCA. No es necesario tener experiencia, pero los competidores deben estar conocer los Reglamentos El acceso a invitados y espectadores será gratuita. Esta competencia participa en el Mes oficial de recién llegados de la WCA 2024. El proceso de registro dará prioridad a los nuevos competidores para el registro, y los competidores que regresen serán aceptados después. Se considera que los nuevos competidores no tienen ID de la WCA o tienen una ID de la WCA de 2024. Se considera que los competidores que regresan tienen una ID de la WCA de 2023 o anterior. Todos los competidores aún deben seguir todos los requisitos de registro para que su registro se considere completo. Los competidores que ya han competido se pueden registrar en cualquier momento durante el período de registro, pero su registro será aceptado según lo siguiente : * El primer 50% de las plazas, según lo definido por el límite de competidores, está reservado para nuevos competidores. * Si el 50% de los lugares están ocupados por nuevos competidores, los competidores que regresan serán aceptados por orden de llegada. * Si el 50% de los lugares no están ocupados por nuevos competidores antes del cierre de registro dos semanas antes de la competencia, se aceptarán los lugares restantes, hasta el límite de competidores, de los competidores registrados que regresan. _____ **English version** **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024 Is a second competition of the new year 2024. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations The competition is free to spectators and guests. This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following: The first 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. If 50% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. If 50% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.name: Graz Open 2024
items.information: ##### *English version is below* ​ #### **Deutsch:** ​ Speedcubing ist wieder zurück in Graz! Elf Jahre nach der letzten Competition freuen wir uns Graz Open 2024 als offizielles WCA Turnier anzukündigen. ​ Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. ​ Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! ​ Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. ​ ​ Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ​ ----- ​ #### **English:** ​ Speedcubing is back in Graz! Eleven years after the last competition, we are pleased to announce the Graz Open 2024 as an official WCA tournament. ​ The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. ​ The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. ​ Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1ZsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c6e9fe6551a0ccb8658afed67be40e057fe6ac2/Mololoa_logo.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2024, la **segunda competencia oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 23 y domingo 24 de marzo de 2024. El Mololoa Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2024, the **second official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, March 23, and Sunday, March 24, 2024. Mololoa Open 2024 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours dans le cadre du **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA**. 30% des places seront réservées aux nouveaux venus (voir **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA** au bas de cette page pour plus d'informations). Vous pouvez choisir entre [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (samedi) et [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (dimanche). Ces compétitions sont identiques à l'exception du jour où elles se déroulent. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. C'est une excellente occasion pour les nouveaux venus de participer à certaines ou à toutes les épreuves de 3x3x3 cube, de 2x2x2 cube, de pyraminx, de skewb et de 3x3x3 cube à une main! De plus, dans le cadre du mois des nouveaux venus de la WCA, nous aurons des prix spéciaux et des initiatives pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 30% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. * If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGhZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--392ac2f0728e8e69ef497494e33b38b6b56bc2f4/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0.png) # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1 This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. **The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. ##### Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. For more information, please check the tabs! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2xiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e4ca2771e9de59b2b4ec158347f69fed9d1d546/SI.png) Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija. Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**. To tekmovanje je vključeno v uraden WCA mesec novincev 2024. **Pri prijavah je 50% mest rezerviranih za novince.** Za novince se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki so še brez WCA ID-ja ali imajo WCA ID z začetkom 2024. Za povratnike se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki imajo WCA ID iz leta 2023 ali prej. Vsi tekmovalci morajo še vedno upoštevati vse zahteve za prijavo, da se njihova prijava šteje za popolno. ##### Prijave bodo sprejete na naslednji način: - 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev je rezerviranih za novince. - Na začetku je 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev na voljo za povratnike. Prijave bodo sprejete po običajnem redu - po vrstnem redu, kot bodo izpolnjeni vsi pogoji. - Če se prijavi več kot 50% novincev preden se zapolni preostalih 50% mest s povratniki, se nadaljnje prijave sprejemajo po običajnem redu za novince in povratnike hkrati. - Če novinci ne zapolnijo rezerviranih mest pred koncem prijav, dva tedna pred tekmovanjem, bodo preostala mesta zapolnjena s povratniki na čakalni listi do zapolnitve mest. items.information: [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Polokwane competition of 2024! This competition has a focus on holding popular events to give newer competitors an easy oppurtunity to start competing with the rest of the South African cubing community. The competition is open to **anyone** who knows how to solve a cube! Whether you take 20 seconds or 5 minutes to solve the 3x3 we will be happy to have you! ## Newcomers and returners This competition will recognise both a newcomer and experienced competitor podium across all the events. Be sure to stick around for the chance to meet and compete with other cubers! ##### ALL NEW COMPETITORS If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ## Volunteers We will require volunteers to support with running, judging and scrambling on the day. We will demonstrate the process for these duties during the new competitor tutorial, and encourage everyone to get involved. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact) We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information: **English** We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony! **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen! **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.information: ###Português O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas! Algumas informações importantes: * É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução. * Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.** Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))** As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.** ###English Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great! Some important information: * It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed. * Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **Attention**: This competition has a competitor limit. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com)).** Entries must be paid **through Stripe** in the **Register** tab.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: (BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!** Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024! A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil. Nos vemos lá! (EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!** While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*! The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil. See you there!

items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Vitória 2024 é o 17º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** The Summer Kube Vitória 2024 is the 17th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to welcome you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition location 30 minutes before the sport you will participate in; - The cube you are going to compete in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information: We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ## VENUE HEAT This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1ZjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8dda97be6311cbc39f24bfeb67943a83dd3c5737/logo.png) A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2023 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Hike 2 Cube Kenya 2023
items.information: Welcome! This will be the world's first ever WCA competition on top of a mountain! Please go through each and every tab for all the information about this trip, and let the organiser know about any specific quiries you may have. We will be hiking to the top of Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo). It is going to be a 9 kilometer walk to the top, and another 9 to come back down... This competition is recommended for only competitors aged 12 and above. Those who are aged younger may have difficulties walking long distances. It will be a road trip from the capital, Nairobi, to the venue in Machakos, and back. Competitors also have the option to drive up the mountain (provided they have their own personal vehicles) incase they are not in a position to hike. Make sure to inform the organiser in advance if this will be the case.

Caso deseje alterar seus eventos, deve contactar os Delegados ou Organização. If you sign up for two of them, we'll take it into account as if you'd chosen the one with fewer participants. In other words, if Event A has 10 entrants and Event B has 5, and you sign up for both, we will exclude your entry from Event A. You don't have to sign up for all Events. If you don't want to take part in either of the two taking place at any given time, you don't need to register for either. items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens. ### Masters and Challengers This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes! ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ### Spectators As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited. ### Volunteering Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### Sponsorship Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners! ### Lucky Draw During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 para os competidores, pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA; 3. Atentar-se ao cronograma da competição. Este ano, por conta da prova do ENEM no dia 12/11, optamos por colocar as modalidades mais tradicionais e normalmente com maior número de inscritos no primeiro dia de competição (11/11, sábado). Atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus respectivos cortes/limites; 4. Caso queira adquirir a camiseta do campeonato, entre em contato com o organizador através do email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. Para informações adicionais verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador via email (welbertmoutta@gmail.com). **ENGLISH** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules; 3. Pay attention to the competition schedule. This year, due to the ENEM test on 11/12, we chose to put the more traditional events and usually with the highest number of competitors on the first day of competition (11/11, Saturday) Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 4. If you want to purchase the championship t-shirt, contact the organizer via email welbertmoutta@gmail.com; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com).

items.name: Warsaw Cube Masters 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png) #### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca! Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe. Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt". --- #### Warsaw Cube Masters returns! We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition. Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento! * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun! --- ### Realização: **Grupo Escoteiro Verde Vale - 3/PR** ### Apoio: **Associação Guarda Mirim de Londrina**

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.** **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0pMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bcff7b5bdf0f0846e919c48b2fc43d8a54c9d36f/UKC%202023%20LOGO%20-%20RGB%20(FOR%20SCREENS)%20-%20(TRANSPARENT)%20-%20(WITH%20SPONSORSHIP).png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2hMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--14c85d7c918289412994eb77f529bb474910e16e/image.png) Το Salonica Autumn Open '23 είναι o τελευταίος διαγωνισμός αυτής της σειράς για το 2023 στο δρόμο για τα πρώτα Greek Nationals! Είμαστε πλέον πολύ περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Αυτή τη φορά επισκεπτόμαστε τη βόρεια Ελλάδα και την αγαπημένη μας συμπρωτεύουσα τη Θεσσαλονίκη! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Salonica Autumn Open 2023 is the last competition of the Road to the first Greek Nationals series of this year! We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! items.information: 🇧🇷 O Kube Kids Vila Velha 2023 é o 16º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KubeKidsVilaVelha2023/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Kube Kids Vila Velha 2023 is the 16th Official Espírito Santo Competition. We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KubeKidsVilaVelha2023/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Ontario Favourites Fall 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesFall2023).
